name: burke-odoo-__INSTANCE_LABEL__-readonly
description: Read-only access to Burke Truck & Equipment Odoo. Ask questions in plain English; nothing can be changed. Requires uv.
long_description:
Burke's hardened build of odoo-mcp, packaged read-only for the team.

What it does: search and read Odoo records, run server-side aggregations, inspect schema, and produce accounting/aging reports for __ODOO_DB__.

What it cannot do: create, change or delete any Odoo record, post to a chatter thread, or send email. The write tools are removed from the tool surface at startup, not merely disabled — see tools_filtered in health_check.

Field masking: margin, cost, banking details, and employee personal data are removed from results by the bundled field-ACL policy. Masked fields come back listed under redacted_fields rather than as values. Note that masking applies to returned fields, not to domain filters.

Credentials: your own Odoo login and API key, entered once in the install dialog and held by the OS keychain. Never share a key between people — the report from check_api_key_expiry only covers the key it is using.

Build provenance: odoo-mcp __VERSION__, git __GIT_DESCRIBE__. Verify with health_check: package_version must show the +burke suffix. A bare version means the machine is running upstream from PyPI, which does not contain any of the Burke safety behaviors.

env.ODOO_MCP_ROTATION_DOC: Ask Dalton to rotate this key. Runbook: docs/credential-lifecycle.md in djonesburke/mcp-odoo.

odoo_username.title: Your Odoo login
odoo_username.description: The email address you sign in to Odoo with, e.g. you@burketruck.com

odoo_api_key.title: Your Odoo API key
odoo_api_key.description: In Odoo: profile menu → My Profile → Account Security → New API Key. Use your own key, not someone else's. Ask Dalton if you do not have one.
